you_should_know.title: Kendall County residents raise privacy concerns over Flock cameras
you_should_know.summary: In Kendall County, the Hill Country county about 30 miles northwest of San Antonio, petitions are gaining momentum to remove Flock cameras — automated license plate readers — while officials highlight their crime-solving benefits.
you_should_know.description: In Kendall County, petitions are gaining momentum to remove Flock cameras, while officials highlight their crime-solving benefits.

you_should_know.title: Meta, Open AI commit to Texas data center rules as Gov. Abbott orders strict power, water audits
you_should_know.summary: As AI data centers face backlash in North Texas, the Dallas-Fort Worth region up the interstate from San Antonio, Meta, Google and Open AI promise to play by Gov. Abbott's new rules to protect the grid.
